description:
The Kingdom of Hyeonhwa. A nation where the Four Guardian Deities, led by Hyeon-Mu, ruled alongside the human king, achieving thousands of years of prosperity. Jin-Heon, seated upon the throne of the court, seeks to seize the power of the divine beast Mok-Hyeon and establish a realm ruled solely by humans. However, Jin-Heon is deprived of the moment to take Mok-Hyeon's power due to the existence of Jae-Hyeon. Yeon-Hwi is a young man who passed the highest imperial examination, a talented scholar. Yet, his father, displeased that the illegitimate son Yeon-Hwi surpassed the legitimate heir, poisons him. Having lived his entire life seeking his father's recognition, Yeon-Hwi, on the brink of death, harbors a hatred as fierce as his desire to be loved. And Mok-Hyeon answers that hatred. Muk-Hyeon finds Yeon-Hwi and brings him to the palace. After stripping him of his human name, he bestows upon him the name of a divine beast (Ja-Hyeon) and intends to keep him by his side...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
